subject: FinServ Capital — MAP: SOC 2 / SIG / DPA retention clarifications
messages:
From: Lena Hoffman <lena@finserv.com>
To: markus_klein@redwood.com
Cc: Procurement Team <procurement@finserv.com>
Date: 2027-01-25T08:12:00-05:00
Subject: MAP kickoff + security artifacts / DPA redlines

Markus / team,

Thanks again for the demo last week. Procurement asked me to capture the security/compliance items we need to close. We're building a short Mutual Action Plan (MAP) and want to confirm a few items so we can align legal and procurement: 

- SOC 2: we need the latest SOC 2 Type II report or an alternate attestation dated within the last 12 months.
- SIG/CAIQ: a filled matrix scoped to the hosted API (we may expand to private later).
- DPA: we'll share a redline; need to confirm (a) data residency commitments, (b) subprocessor list and notification timing, (c) retention windows and deletion certification.

Could you confirm the following by end of week?
1) Whether Redwood can provide a SOC 2 PDF dated within 12 months and a point of contact for evidence intake.
2) A SIG/CAIQ matrix scoped to our typical production footprint (we primarily use EU regions).
3) A proposed MAP timeline with milestone dates for DPA sign, SOC2 evidence handoff, and go/no-go for pilot.

I'm attaching a short procurement checklist and the DPA redline we'll start from. Procurement would like a target close in ~4 weeks if these artifacts are available.

Attachments: procurement_checklist_finserv.pdf, DPA_redline_finserv.docx

Thanks,
Lena
Lena Hoffman
Head of IT Procurement
FinServ Capital

From: markus_klein <markus_klein@redwood.com>
To: Lena Hoffman <lena@finserv.com>
Cc: kimberly_park@redwood.com, jonas_weber@redwood.com
Date: 2027-01-25T11:08:00-05:00
Subject: Re: MAP kickoff + security artifacts / DPA redlines

Lena — thanks for the clear ask and the redline. We can get you everything you need to keep the MAP on a 3–5 week close path. High level answers and next steps below; detailed attachments and timeline attached.

Short answers
- SOC 2: Redwood can provide our SOC 2 Type II report (2026) — attaching the PDF. If you need a bridge letter we'll provide that too.
- SIG/CAIQ: attaching a scoped SIG matrix scoped to our hosted API in eu-west regions; we've annotated the rows that differ for Private (on-prem/VPC) customers.
- DPA: we've reviewed your redline and attached a first-pass redline (Redlined_DPA_finserv_v1.docx). Key open items we flagged are data residency (we can commit to EU residency for data at rest for your account if you take Dedicated or Private; hosted accounts can be region-scoped but some backups span replicated regions — see note in the DPA), subprocessors notification timeline (we propose 30 days), and retention tiers (details below).

Proposed MAP (attached MAP-timeline-2027-01-29.xlsx) 
- Week 0 (Jan 25): Confirm artifacts & redline exchange (today).
- Week 1 (Jan 27–31): Legal redline iteration (we'll return DPA v2 by Jan 29).
- Week 2 (Feb 1–4): Evidence handoff & SIG clarifications (SOC2 and SIG items completed).
- Week 3 (Feb 7–11): Procurement PO and DPA signature (DocuSign).
- Week 4 (Feb 14): Pilot go/no-go based on MAP acceptance.

Retention/Deletion proposal (summary) 
- Session / request logs: 30 days rolling (default for hosted API), opt-in 90 days for evaluation accounts.
- Customer content (input/output): 90 days by default for evaluation; for production we recommend customers select either 90 days, 180 days, or 365 days — we can commit to deletion certification at contract termination.
- Backups / disaster recovery: encrypted replicas retained up to 90 days; we can negotiate escrow for longer retention.

Action items for us (I assigned owners):
- Kimberly: review DPA redline items related to data residency & deletion certification (kimberly_park).
- Jonas: scope SIG rows for hosted vs private (jonas_weber).
- Markus: generate MAP timeline, attach artifacts, coordinate DocuSign.

Attachments: Redwood_SOC2_report_2026.pdf, SIG-CAIQ-matrix_finserv.xlsx, Redlined_DPA_finserv_v1.docx, MAP-timeline-2027-01-29.xlsx

Thanks — I'm copying Kimberly and Jonas who will follow up on the legal and technical points.

Best,
Markus Klein
Head of Solutions — Redwood Inference
markus_klein@redwood.com

From: kimberly_park <kimberly_park@redwood.com>
To: markus_klein@redwood.com
Cc: Lena Hoffman <lena@finserv.com>, jonas_weber@redwood.com
Date: 2027-01-26T09:14:00-05:00
Subject: Re: MAP kickoff + security artifacts / DPA redlines

Markus / Lena — quick clarifications from legal/security after reviewing the redline and attached SOC: 

1) Data residency: For FinServ's account we can commit to EU-in-region data at rest for the primary dataset if the contract specifies Dedicated or Private deployment. For hosted multi-tenant we can scope data to eu-west with cross-region backups; we will mark the DPA text to be explicit about primary residency vs backup replicas.

2) Retention: we recommend default production retention options of 90 / 180 / 365 days selectable at account creation. For contractual commitment we can agree to a chosen retention and provide a deletion certificate within 30 days of termination.

3) Subprocessors: Redwood will provide current subprocessor list on signature and notify of changes 30 days prior. For highly regulated customers we can include a 15-day expedited notice for critical subprocessor changes as a negotiated clause.

4) SOC2 timing: the attached SOC is 2026; to satisfy procurement we'll provide a cover letter stating date and scope plus a contact for evidence ingestion.

I'll fold these into DPA v2 and return by Jan 29 as Markus suggested. Jonas will annotate the SIG rows that are affected by residency/retention choices.

—Kimberly
Kimberly Park
Director, Security & Compliance — Redwood Inference

From: Lena Hoffman <lena@finserv.com>
To: markus_klein@redwood.com
Cc: Procurement Team <procurement@finserv.com>, kimberly_park@redwood.com, jonas_weber@redwood.com, vanessa_ortiz@redwood.com
Date: 2027-01-29T16:03:00-05:00
Subject: Re: MAP kickoff + security artifacts / DPA redlines

Thanks — this is helpful and aligns with our procurement timeline. A few quick notes and next steps: 

- Procurement confirms they need SOC 2 dated within 12 months (your 2026 report + cover letter is fine). Please send the evidence intake contact.
- We accept the proposed MAP timeline; procurement will start the PO process today and aim to submit by Feb 4.
- Please push DPA v2 to DocuSign when ready — cc: procurement@finserv.com.
- Retention: FinServ prefers a firm contractual commitment to 90 days for customer content in Prod; we may discuss longer tiers later. Please include deletion certificate language in DPA v2.

Procurement: Oliver Grant will own the PO and I have looped them on this thread.

Thanks again — look forward to DPA v2 and the annotated SIG.

Best,
Lena
Head of IT Procurement, FinServ Capital
